era: 1931 fictional town; historical stone-street material references
source: Original procedural textures; Antigravity draft reviewed and integrated locally
surfaceWeather: Restrained dampness is an art proposal, not an asserted historical rain event

color_conventions.Base: sRGB 24-bit RGB, diffuse albedo without baked lighting, shadows, or road paint
color_conventions.Normal: Linear 24-bit RGB tangent-space (+X right, +Y bitangent green up, +Z normal out), normalized [0..255]
color_conventions.Mask: Linear 32-bit RGBA (R: 0 / Metallic=0, G: 255 / AO=1.0, B: 0 / Detail=0, A: Smoothness linear [0.0..1.0] -> [0..255])
color_conventions.Height: Linear 8-bit grayscale [0..255], displacement / height relative field

RoadSetts.description: Grey granite dressed paving blocks (~0.25m x 0.16m, 16x24 courses with 50% staggered running bond)

FootwayFlags.description: Warm greige sandstone flagstones (~0.8m x 0.6m, 5x6 courses with 50% staggered running bond)

KerbStone.description: Continuous dressed grey stone grain without grid for kerb edges and curbing
